notes: Card: ' ' x24 before two-digit numerals after around/over/estimated/from; promotes ' fifty', ' twenty', ' thirty' and suppresses unit words, with the - pole on small measurements (2.5m, 1.4 mg). Very sparse and heavy-tailed (max 604, 0.001% above 0.3 of max). One probe round did NOT reproduce it: 'around 12 million people' 0.001, 'estimated 68 million' 0.11, so I expect this test to fail; registered as the card's best reading.
